Using the determinant formula, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}a\times b & =|\begin{aligned}i & j & k \\ 1 & 2 & -5 \\ -3 & 4 & 1\end{aligned}| \\  & =|\begin{aligned}2 & -5 \\ 4 & 1\end{aligned}|i-|\begin{aligned}1 & -5 \\ -3 & 1\end{aligned}|j+|\begin{aligned}1 & 2 \\ -3 & 4\end{aligned}|k \\  & =(2\cdot 1-(-5)(4))i-(1\cdot 1-(-5)(-3))j+(1\cdot 4-2\cdot (-3))k \\  & =(2+20)i-(1-15)j+(4+6)k \\  & =22\,i+14\,j+10\,k\end{aligned}
$$
